description: This file contains inline functions and API declarations for a binary search tree data structure, including node traversal, insertion, removal, and iteration functions.

methods.name: ds_tree_find
methods.description: Finds a node in the tree matching the given key.

methods.name: ds_tree_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the tree is empty.

methods.name: ds_tree_head
methods.description: Returns the lowest (smallest) element in the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_tail
methods.description: Returns the highest (largest) element in the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the tree after the given data.

methods.name: ds_tree_prev
methods.description: Returns the previous element in the tree before the given data.

methods.name: ds_tree_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_remove_head
methods.description: Removes the lowest element from the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_remove_tail
methods.description: Removes the highest element from the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_ifirst
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to the first element in the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_inext
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: ds_tree_iremove
methods.description: Removes the current element during iteration.
